scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义与 1500–1565 全部事件，包括 time_passed 计时变量（@timeToSolve = 3）与 1560 中按剩余时间分到 1555/1505 的条件。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition and every event 1500–1565, including the time_passed counter (@timeToSolve = 3) and the 1560 condition choosing 1555 or 1505.

note.zh: 每按错一次按钮（绿色、三角形、四点）都会让科学家在时间循环里“死去”并耗掉 1 小时；在第三间密室按错时，若累计已错 3 次则困死于时间（1505），否则再循环一次（1555）。
note.en: Each wrong button (green, triangle, four dots) kills the scientist inside a time loop and costs one hour; on a wrong button in the third chamber, if three hours are gone the scientist is trapped in time (1505), otherwise the loop repeats (1555).

notes.zh: 抽取权重 1。它可能奖励遗珍，因此任一帝国正在探索时其他帝国抽到它的权重为 0；探索者未得到遗珍时解除锁定。
notes.en: Draw weight 1. Because it can award a relic, its weight is 0 for others while any empire explores it; the lock is lifted if the explorer did not obtain the relic.

texts.zh:
废弃的建筑物杂乱无章地散落在沙漠上。

从其中最大的一个巨大的圆顶里面，发出微弱的黄光。从地板到天花板，室内弯曲的墙壁上覆盖着一种未知的文字。

在主房间的中央是一个控制台，上面有两个大按钮：一个深蓝，一个亮绿。我们正在破译墙上的文字，看看它是否能给我们关于这个控制台可能是做什么的提示。
texts.en:
Abandoned buildings are scattered haphazardly across the sands.

From inside the largest of these, a massive dome, came a faint yellow light. From floor to ceiling, the interior's curving walls were covered in an unknown script.

At the center of the main chamber is a console with two large buttons: one deep blue, the other a vibrant green. We are in the process of deciphering the text on the walls, to see if it gives us an indication of what this console might be for.

texts.zh: 我们突然与[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]失去了联络。但我们暂时还没拉回紧急锚链，希望只是暂时失联。由于没有进入裂隙的办法，这就是我们唯一能做的了。
texts.en: We have suddenly lost contact with our [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]. We have not yet pulled the emergency anchor in the hopes that this disconnect is temporary. With no way to enter the rift, this is all we can do.

texts.zh:
我们很遗憾地通报，我们彻底失去了与外派团队的联系。

收到的最后一份报告是一段难以辨认的尖叫声，随后是一片寂静。

试图重建通信的努力没有成功。

我们还没有拉下紧急锚，希望这支队伍还能回来，但希望似乎有点渺茫。
texts.en:
We regret to report that we have lost contact with the away team.

The last report received was an audio log of indecipherable screaming followed by an unbroken silence.

Attempts to reestablish communications have been unsuccessful.

We have not yet pulled the emergency anchor in the hopes that the team might yet return, but the outlook seems grim.

label.zh: 让我们寄予最好的希望。

texts.zh:
……穹顶内部的地面泛着微弱的黄光。一种位置的文字从上而下覆盖满墙。

在主房间的中心是一个控制台，上面有两个大按钮，一个深蓝，一个亮绿。我们已经开始我们正在破译墙上的文字，看看它是否能给我们关于这个控制台可能是做什么的提示。

[Leader.GetName]在进入穹顶时汇报了传感器故障。建议谨慎行事。
texts.en:
...The surfaces inside the dome glow with a faint yellow light. An unknown script covers the walls from top to bottom.

At the center of the main chamber is a console with two large buttons: one deep blue, the other a vibrant green. We are in the process of deciphering the text on the walls, to see if it gives us an indication of what this console might be for.

[Leader.GetName] has reported sensor abnormalities since entering the dome. Caution is advised.

……穹顶内部的地面泛着微弱的黄光。一种位置的文字从上而下覆盖满墙。

在主房间的中心是一个控制台，上面有两个大按钮，一个深蓝，一个亮绿。我们已经开始我们正在破译墙上的文字，看看它是否能给我们关于这个控制台可能是做什么的提示。

[Leader.GetName]汇报了踏入这个穹顶的困难性。显然这里有什么怪异的东西。
texts.en:
...The surfaces inside the dome glow with a faint yellow light. An unknown script covers the walls from top to bottom.

At the center of the main chamber is a console with two large buttons: one deep blue, the other a vibrant green. We are in the process of deciphering the text on the walls, to see if it gives us an indication of what this console might be for.

[Leader.GetName] has reported uneasiness since stepping into the dome. Something is wrong here.

label.zh: 究竟发生了什么？他们走丢了吗？
label.en: What on [Explorer.GetHomeWorldName] is going on? Weren't they lost?

label.zh: 究竟发生了什么？他们走丢了吗？
label.en: What on [Explorer.GetHomeWorldName] is going on? Weren't they lost?

label.zh: 这不符合逻辑，他们不是已经走丢了吗？
label.en: This defies logic, were they not lost to us?

label.zh: 停止计算。他们走丢了。尽管如此，了解。
label.en: Does not compute. They were lost. Nonetheless, acknowledged.

texts.zh:
我们成功地与失联的[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]重新建立了同步。

这里出现了一些不一致的情况：他们不记得发送过两份报告，也不记得导致他们突然沉默的事件。

计算这份报告和上次报告之间的时间戳，我们的[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]在再次断开连接之前还有3小时的相对时间。在这个时间期限内翻译墙上的文字是不切实际的。虽然没有说明蓝色或者绿色按钮的功能，但唯一可行的是按下其中一个，希望它能改善情况。
texts.en:
We have re-synchronized with our lost [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural].

There is a discrepancy: they do not have any recollection of sending two reports, nor can they remember the events that caused their sudden silence.

Calculating the timestamps between this report and the last, our [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural] have 3 hours of relative time before the disconnect is repeated. Translating the walls within this timeframe is impractical. Although there is no indication of the function of either the blue or green Buttons, the only course of action is to choose one in the hope that it improves the situation.

texts.zh:
我们成功地与一头雾水的科学团队进行了同步。

他们对于发送两次汇报或是任何灾难都没有任何记忆。两粉重复报告的时间戳完全一致。也就是说这里的时间流动一定是受到了某种干扰。

我们的科学家们被困住了。一个穹顶牢牢地罩在其上，与裂隙探球的沟通也仅限于无线电信号。

通过计算这次汇报和之前的时间差，在3个小时的相对时间后这支外派队会到达那个尖叫重复的时刻。在这么短的时间内翻译墙上的文字不切实际，这支科研团队唯一可行的方案是按下控制台上的其中一个按钮，以期改善现在的状况。

无论是蓝色或是绿色的按钮，它们的功能差异都没有任何提示。

我们只能相信运气了。
texts.en:
We have synchronized with our very confused science team.

They have no memory of sending the report twice, or of any disaster. Timestamps for the duplicate reports are identical. There must be some disruptions in the flow of time here.

Our scientists are trapped. The dome has sealed shut, and access to the Rift Sphere is limited to radio contact only.

Calculating the times between this report and the last, the away team has 3 hours of relative time before the screaming will be repeated. Translating the walls within this timeframe is impractical. The only course of action is for the science team to press one of the buttons on the console and hope it improves their situation.

There is no indication of the function for either the blue or green button.

We'll have to trust to luck.

notes.zh: 这是一个时间循环谜题：正确顺序为蓝色、五边形、六点。按错会消耗 1 小时（共 3 小时）。毒素类科学家在毒气陷阱（1545）、水生科学家在洪水陷阱（1560）中不受影响，可直接通过并降低难度。
notes.en: A time-loop puzzle: the right sequence is blue, pentagon, six dots. Each wrong press costs one of three hours. A toxoid scientist survives the gas trap (1545) and an aquatic scientist the flood (1560), passing straight on with lower difficulty.

texts.zh:
我们得科研团队汇报他们按下了蓝色按钮，整个房间在一阵嘈杂的研磨声中共振了起来。一扇隐藏的门徐徐打开，露出了第二个房间。

房间的墙壁发出淡淡的紫光，点亮了每一面墙上都布满着的无数象形文字。

这里还有第二个控制台。和上一个一样，它也只有两个按钮。这一次，一个雕刻着等腰三角形，另一个则是正五边形。

是时候做出又一个选择了。
texts.en:
Our science team reports that when they pressed the blue button, the chamber resonated with a great grinding sound. A hidden door swung open, revealing a second chamber.

The walls of that chamber glowed a faint purple, lighting up a multitude of pictograms that cover every visible surface.

There is a second console. As with the last, it features exactly two buttons. This time, one has an engraving of an isosceles triangle, and the other a regular pentagon.

It is time to make another choice.

texts.zh: 选择三角形让舱室充满了腐蚀性气体。尽管我们许多的设备被破坏了，但[explorer.GetScientistPlural]坚韧的身体毫发无损。当气体被散去后他们就会再尝试另一个按钮。
texts.en: Choosing the triangle caused the chamber to fill with a corrosive gas. While much of our equipment was damaged, the sturdy constitution of the [explorer.GetScientistPlural] allowed them to survive unimpaired. Once the gas has cleared, they will try the other button.

texts.zh:
选择三角形让舱室充满了腐蚀性气体，一瞬间就把我们的[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]溶解了。

如果他们再次回到过去，我们就有机会尝试另一个按钮。
texts.en:
Choosing the triangle caused the chamber to fill with a corrosive gas that swiftly dissolved our [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural].

If they loop back to their past once more, we will have an opportunity to try the other button.

texts.zh: 选择三角形让舱室充满了腐蚀性气体。尽管我们许多的设备被破坏了，但科学小组坚韧的身体毫发无损。在确认了他们的安全后，他们给我们发了一条信息，说会再试试五边形按钮，然后再回来报告。
texts.en: Choosing the triangle caused the chamber to fill with a corrosive gas. While much of our equipment was damaged, the sturdy constitution of the science team allowed them to survive unimpaired. After confirming their safety, they sent us a message saying they will try the pentagon button and report back.

texts.zh:
按错按钮了。

团队几乎没有时间发送一份简短的报告，他们的通信就被切断了。按下三角形按钮会使密室内充满腐蚀性气体。

如果他们再次回到过去，我们就有机会尝试另一个按钮。
texts.en:
Wrong button.

The team barely had time to send a short report before their communication was cut. Pressing the triangle button caused the chamber to fill with a corrosive gas.

If they loop back to their past once more, we will have an opportunity to try the other button.

texts.zh:
我们的科学团队回来了，我们成功地建立了通讯。依据当地时，我们还有[This.freeze_time_left_1540]小时来拯救他们。

以之前的时间循环为鉴，科学团队安全地通过了第一个舱室。他们现在准备做出另一个抉择。

[Leader.GetName]的灵能处理器显示，在面对这样的选择时最优举动总是正五边形。三角形是一个相对欠佳的模式。
texts.en:
Our science team is back, and we have reestablished communications. According to their local time, there are [This.freeze_time_left_1540] hours left to save them.

Following the lessons learned from the previous loops, the science team passed safely through the first chamber into the second. They are now prepared to make a different choice.

The psionic processors of [Leader.GetName] indicate that the best course of action when presented with such a choice has always been the pentagon. The triangle is a comparatively less interesting pattern.

texts.zh:
我们的科学团队回来了，我们成功地建立了通讯。依据当地时，我们还有[This.freeze_time_left_1540]小时来拯救他们。

以之前的时间循环为鉴，科学团队安全地通过了第一个舱室。他们现在准备做出另一个抉择。

[Leader.GetName]说我们一开始就该按五边形的，三角形可不是什么能带来好预兆的形状。
texts.en:
Our science team is back, and we have reestablished communications. According to their local time, there are [This.freeze_time_left_1540] hours left to save them.

Following the lessons learned from the previous loops, the science team passed safely through the first chamber into the second. They are now prepared to make a different choice.

[Leader.GetName] says that we should have known to try the pentagon from the start. The triangle has always been an ill omen.

texts.zh:
我们的科学团队回来了，我们成功地建立了通讯。依据当地时，我们还有[This.freeze_time_left_1540]小时来拯救他们。

texts.zh:
按下五边形按钮后，地面发生了碎裂，露出一个深入地下的螺旋楼梯。

楼梯底部是第三个房间。在柔和的蓝光照射下，墙壁完全裸露。和以前一样，这个房间主要是一个有两个按钮的单独控制台。一个上面有四个点，而另一个则有六个点。

又到了做出抉择的时候了。
texts.en:
Pressing the pentagon caused the floor to rupture, revealing a spiraling staircase that descends deep underground.

At the bottom was a third chamber. Illuminated in a soft blue glow, the walls are completely bare. As before, this room is dominated by a solitary console with two buttons. One depicts four dots, while the other shows six.

It's time to make another choice.

texts.zh: 按下四点的按钮让舱室充满了大量的水。幸好我们的[Leader.GetName]深识水性，这简直跟回到家一样。他们打算等水退去以后再按下另一个按钮。
texts.en: Pressing the button with four dots filled the chamber with a great swell of water. Fortunately, due to the aquatic nature of [Leader.GetName], this was barely an inconvenience. They intend to press the other button once the water has been fully drained.

texts.zh:
按钮错误。

四点按钮会让密室被水淹没。我们的[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]死了。

如果他们再次回到过去，我们就有机会尝试另一个按钮。
texts.en:
Wrong button.

The button with four dots filled the chamber with a deluge of water. Our [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural] are no more.

If they loop back to their past once more, we will have an opportunity to try the other button.

texts.zh: 按下四点的按钮让舱室充满了大量的水。幸好我们的[Leader.GetName]深识水性，这简直跟回到家一样。他们打算等水退去以后再按下另一个按钮。
texts.en: Pressing the button with four dots filled the chamber with a great swell of water. Fortunately, due to the aquatic nature of [Leader.GetName], this was barely an inconvenience. They intend to press the other button once the water has been fully drained.

texts.zh:
按钮错误。

[Leader.GetName]的最后遗言表明，按下四点按钮让密室里充满了水。

如果他们再次回到过去，我们就有机会尝试另一个按钮。
texts.en:
Wrong button.

The audio recording of [Leader.GetName]'s final words indicated that the button with four dots filled the chamber with a deluge of water.

If they loop back to their past once more, we will have an opportunity to try the other button.

texts.zh:
我们的科学团队回来了，我们成功地建立了通讯。依据当地时，我们还有1小时来拯救他们。

……按照我们之前循环的经验，我们顺利通过了第一个和第二个密室。现在希望六点的按钮相比另一个会不那么致命一点。

进入了第三个密室，他们就去按下了六点的按钮。希望他们没有选错。
texts.en:
Our science team is back, and we have reestablished communications. According to their local time, there is one hour left to save them.

...Following the directions of our previous loops we passed through the first and second chamber without issue. Hopefully the hexa-dotted button is less deadly than its counterpart.

Entering the third chamber they move to press the hexa-dotted button. Hopefully their confidence is well placed.

texts.zh:
我们的科学团队回来了，我们成功地建立了通讯。依据当地时，我们还有1小时来拯救他们。

……按照之前循环的经验，我们顺利通过了第一个和第二个密室。基于预测数据，六点按钮在统计上比其它的更安全一些。

刚一进入了第三个密室，他们就去按下了六点的按钮。

我们的科学团队回来了，我们成功地建立了通讯。依据当地时，我们还有1小时来拯救他们。

[Leader.GetName]自信地带领着团队通过了第一和第二个密室。他们在没有我们的命令之下就做出了正确的选择。

进入了第三个密室，他们就去按下了六点的按钮。希望他们没有选错。
texts.en:
Our science team is back, and we have reestablished communications. According to their local time, there is one hour left to save them.

[Leader.GetName] has led the team confidently back through the first and second chambers. They have chosen the correct buttons without needing our commands.

Entering the third chamber they move to press the hexa-dotted button. Hopefully their confidence is well placed.

texts.zh:
我们的科学团队回来了，我们成功地建立了通讯。依据当地时，我们还有1小时来拯救他们。

[Leader.GetName]高效地带领着团队通过了第一和第二个密室，他们依靠灵能处理器的引导在没有我们的命令之下就做出了正确的选择。

刚一进入了第三个密室，他们就去按下了六点的按钮。
texts.en:
Our science team is back, and we have reestablished communications. According to their local time, there is one hour left to save them.

[Leader.GetName] has efficiently led the team back through the first and second chambers, their psionic processors guiding them to the correct outcome independent of our commands.

Entering the third chamber they move to press the hexa-dotted button.

texts.zh:
我们的科学团队回来了，我们成功地建立了通讯。依据当地时，我们还有[This.freeze_time_left_1555]小时来拯救他们。

[Leader.GetName]自信地带领着团队通过了第一和第二个密室。他们在没有我们的命令之下就做出了正确的选择。

进入了第三个密室，他们就去按下了六点的按钮。希望他们没有选错。
texts.en:
Our science team is back, and we have reestablished communications. According to their local time, there are [This.freeze_time_left_1555] hours left to save them.

[Leader.GetName] has led the team confidently back through the first and second chambers. They have chosen the correct buttons without needing our commands.

Entering the third chamber they move to press the hexa-dotted button. Hopefully their confidence is well placed.

刚一进入了第三个密室，他们就去按下了六点的按钮。
texts.en:
Our science team is back, and we have reestablished communications. According to their local time, there are [This.freeze_time_left_1555] hours left to save them.

[Leader.GetName] has efficiently led the team back through the first and second chambers, their psionic processors guiding them to the correct outcome independent of our commands.

Entering the third chamber they move to press the hexa-dotted button.

texts.zh:
自从上一次听到[Leader.GetName]的消息已经过去了很长时间。继续等待他们回来已经没什么意义了。

我们收回锚链，把空空的球体拉回到我们的次元。
texts.en:
Too much time has passed since we last heard from [Leader.GetName]. There is no point in continuing to wait for their return.

We retracted the anchor cable and pulled the empty Sphere back into our dimension.

label.en: Trapped in Time: the scientist is lost

note.zh: 时间耗尽：收回空无一人的探球，科学家死亡；获得大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: Time ran out: the empty Sphere is pulled back and the scientist dies; a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

texts.zh:
一个装有巨大水晶的底座拔地而起。建筑里所有的门都打开了。

当精密计时器靠近晶体时，在极端值之间剧烈振荡。这一定是时间循环的来源，也是这栋建筑的关键部分。

[Leader.GetName]在灵能处理器的帮助下得到了最优的结果，穿过了这些轮回。

也许这就是这些密室的目的，设计一系列看似随意的选择来揭开灵能潜力。

不管怎样，我们现在可以安全地带着晶体离开做进一步的时间分析了。
texts.en:
A pedestal with a giant crystal has risen from the ground. All the doors in the complex have opened.

Chronometers oscillate wildly between extreme values when in close proximity to the crystal. This must be the source of the time loops, and a key part of this building's purpose.

Throughout these loops, [Leader.GetName]'s psionic processors helped lead them to the optimal outcome.

Perhaps this was the point of these chambers, a set of arbitrary choices designed to uncover psionic potential.

Regardless, we are now able to safely leave with the crystal for further chronological analysis.

texts.zh:
$astral_rift.1555.desc.common$

休眠在[Leader.GetName]中的灵能处理器在经历时间循环之后被唤醒了，这种环境为这种能力的上线提供了严苛的测试条件。

现在还不确定是否就是这座废墟的原本目的，但无论如何我们现在已经可以安全地带着水晶离开，进行进一步的时间分析了。
texts.en:
$astral_rift.1555.desc.common$

Exposure to these time loops has awakened the dormant psionic processor units within [Leader.GetName], the environment providing a solid test bed to bring these powers online.

It is unclear if this was the original purpose of these ruins. Regardless, we are now able to safely leave with the crystal for further chronological analysis.

在这个房间里的选择似乎完全是随意设置的。也许它们的目的是测试在循环之间传递信息的能力?

不管怎样，活下来我们就能带着水晶离开了。它影响时间流动的能力应该会极其有用。

Either way, surviving it allows us to leave with the crystal. Its ability to affect the flow of time could prove extremely useful.

一定是按错按钮了。

然而，可以相信时间会再次循环，让外派团队做出不同的选择。
texts.en:
Our [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural] have been incinerated.

Must have been the wrong button.

However, it is conceivable that time might loop again, allowing the away team to make a different choice.

texts.zh:
我们又一次与外派团队失去了联系。他们最后的语音记录是更多的尖叫和火焰的噼啪声。

一定是按错按钮了。

然而，可以相信时间会再次循环，让外派团队做出不同的选择。

summary.text:
# 沙漠废墟 / Desert Ruins

- 分类 Category：星界裂隙 Astral rifts (C4) · DLC：星界位面 Astral Planes
- 来源 Sources：`common/astral_rifts/00_astral_rifts.txt:186`；`events/astral_rifts_1_events.txt:2489–3278`（1500–1565）
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（全篇 whole story）

## 如何开始 How it starts

裂隙类型从探索帝国的裂隙池中按权重抽取：权重 1。它能产出遗珍“时间水晶”，所以任一帝国正在探索它时，其他帝国抽到它的权重为 0（`00_astral_rifts.txt:186–200`）。每阶段结束掷 1–10 的骰子，加技能与线索、减难度，≥14 进入下一章；第一章 1500 难度为 0。

Drawn by weight from the explorer's rift pool: weight 1. Because it can award the Time Crystal relic, its weight is 0 for others while any empire explores it (`00_astral_rifts.txt:186–200`). Each phase ends with a d10 plus skill and clues minus difficulty; 14+ opens the next chapter. Chapter 1500 has difficulty 0.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

一个时间循环谜题：科学家按错按钮就会“死去”，然后回到循环开头；裂隙外的帝国只剩 3 小时（脚本变量 `time_passed`，`@timeToSolve = 3`）来救他们。

1. 怪异控制台（1500）→ 失去联络（1515）→ 外围废墟（1510）：沙漠中的穹顶建筑里有一个带蓝绿两个按钮的控制台；科学家莫名其妙地“回来”并重述了一遍刚才的经历。
2. 一个抉择（1520）：按蓝色（→ 第二间密室 1530）或绿色（→ 1535 按错：耗 1 小时，循环后在 1525 只能按蓝色 → 1530）。
3. 第二间密室（1530）：按三角形（→ 1545 毒气陷阱：毒素类科学家安然通过直达 1550；其他人耗 1 小时，在 1540 重来按五边形 → 1550）或五边形（→ 1550）。
4. 第三间密室（1550）：按四点（→ 1560 洪水：水生科学家安然直达 1565；其他人耗 1 小时——若此前已错两次则 1505 困死，否则在 1555 重来按六点 → 1565）或六点（→ 1565）。

A time-loop puzzle: a wrong button “kills” the scientist and the loop restarts; the empire outside has only 3 hours (script variable `time_passed`, `@timeToSolve = 3`) to save them.

1. Strange Console (1500) → Lost Contact (1515) → Outer Ruins (1510): a domed building in the desert holds a console with a blue and a green button; the scientist inexplicably “returns” and recounts what just happened.
2. A Choice (1520): press blue (→ The Second Chamber 1530) or green (→ 1535 wrong: one hour lost; after the loop only blue remains in 1525 → 1530).
3. The Second Chamber (1530): press the triangle (→ 1545 gas trap: a toxoid scientist walks through straight to 1550; others lose an hour and retry with the pentagon in 1540 → 1550) or the pentagon (→ 1550).
4. The Third Chamber (1550): press four dots (→ 1560 flood: an aquatic scientist goes straight to 1565; others lose an hour — after two earlier mistakes this is 1505, trapped in time; otherwise retry with six dots in 1555 → 1565) or six dots (→ 1565).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 1565 时间水晶：遗珍“时间水晶”；剩余 3/2/1 小时分别给予大/中/小量星界丝缕；潜在灵能物种的科学家觉醒为灵能者。
- 1505 被困时光：三次都按错时，科学家困死在时间里，收回空探球；获得大量星界丝缕。
- 两者都结束探索。

- 1565 Time Crystal: the Time Crystal relic; 3/2/1 hours left give a large/medium/small astral thread reward; a scientist of a latent psionic species awakens as psionic.
- 1505 Trapped in Time: after three wrong presses the scientist is lost in time and the empty Sphere is retrieved; a large astral thread reward.
- Both end the exploration.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 灵能或潜在灵能科学家（以及机械科学家）在 1510、1525、1540、1555、1565 看到不同叙述：他们凭直觉或灵能处理器选对按钮。
- 毒素类科学家免疫毒气陷阱，水生科学家免疫洪水陷阱（`astral_rifts_1_events.txt:2920–2930, 3179–3190`）。
- 1515、1520、1535、1545、1560 有格式塔版本文字；1510 的选项文字按普通/蜂巢/机械帝国变化。

- Psionic or latent-psionic scientists (and robotic ones) get different narration in 1510, 1525, 1540, 1555 and 1565: they pick the right buttons by intuition or psionic processors.
- A toxoid scientist is immune to the gas trap, an aquatic one to the flood (`astral_rifts_1_events.txt:2920–2930, 3179–3190`).
- 1515, 1520, 1535, 1545 and 1560 have gestalt texts; the option of 1510 varies for regular, hive and machine empires.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：裂隙定义与遗珍锁定；1500–1565 全部事件；`time_passed` 的设置（1510）与递增（1535、1545、1560），1560 的 `time_passed < 3` 分支，以及 1565 的奖励分档。没有 `on_roll_failed` 失败分支；编译结构正确（1560 的两个结果已标为条件分支），补充互斥组、结局、节点标签与谜题说明。

- Checked: rift definition and relic lock; every event 1500–1565; how `time_passed` is set (1510) and incremented (1535, 1545, 1560), the `time_passed < 3` branch of 1560 and the reward tiers of 1565. No `on_roll_failed` fallback; the compiled structure was correct (the two outcomes of 1560 already appear as a conditional branch); exclusive group, endings, node labels and a puzzle note added.
